notes.text: The narrator starts by copying text and opening Claude Design to create a prompt for designing a warm, cozy website for Amber Light Candles.
Claude Design is used to create the initial design of the website based on plain language instructions.
The narrator then moves on to using Claude Code for more advanced tasks, such as building a tool that reads inventory and creates product labels.
Claude Code is used to automate repetitive tasks and build tools that can be run independently on the user's computer.
The narrator demonstrates how Claude Code can be used to create a tool for generating product labels from an inventory spreadsheet.
Claude Code is able to read the inventory file, generate labels based on the data, and save them as a PDF sheet.
The narrator explains that once the tool is created, it can be run independently without needing to interact with Claude Code again.
Claude Code has built a machine that can perform the task of generating product labels automatically.
The narrator emphasizes that this is just one example of how Claude Code can be used to build tools and automate tasks on a computer.
